packageRules.description: agentctl's own agents' images follow the platform they run on, so they name the tags alone: they build on the agentctl base image from the same commit, and the agent builder copies agentctl from main.
rusqlite picks the SQLite linked into agentd, which follows the Microsandbox fork's lockfile, as the comment on it in Cargo.toml says. Move it by hand when the fork moves.
